nodes.title: SG-6.1.3 Validate scene characters against the world's character list
nodes.body:
Context: SceneDef.characters (CharacterSpec[]) is accepted by sceneSchema, but validateWorld in game/src/content/loader.ts only checks dialogue speakers and say events against world.characters, so a scene character with an unknown id passes validation. Desired behavior: validateWorld reports each unknown scene character id with a path-tagged issue. Expected result: unknown ids are rejected and unit tests prove it. Why: scene NPCs must reference declared world characters.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene character whose id is not in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then the returned errors contain an entry tagged with the path scenes.<sceneId>.characters.<index>.id naming the unknown id
- Given a world whose scene characters all exist in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then no character-related error is returned and the-boys-room content still validates


## Scope
- In scope: validateWorld scene character id check
- In scope: unit tests
- Out of scope: character interaction dialogue or action event checks
- Out of scope: schema changes
- Out of scope: Phaser rendering
- Preserve: existing 'unknown character: <id>' messages for speakers and say events
- Preserve: loadWorld behavior


## Technical constraints
- Errors stay plain strings returned from validateWorld(world): string[]


## Definition of done
- Unknown scene character ids are reported
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · validateWorld reports unknown scene character ids with a path-tagged issue
nodes.body:
Context: validateWorld builds a Set of world character ids at loader.ts L121 and iterates scenes at L128-L159 without looking at scene.characters. Desired behavior: for every scene character at index i, if its id is not in the set, push `scenes.<scene.id>.characters.<i>.id: unknown character: <id>`. Expected result: invalid content is rejected with a locatable issue. Why: authors can find the bad entry.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene bedroom has characters[1].id 'ghost' not in world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then errors contains 'scenes.bedroom.characters.1.id: unknown character: ghost'
- Given scene.characters is undefined or all ids are declared, When validateWorld runs, Then no scene character error is added


## Scope
- In scope: loader.ts validateWorld
- Out of scope: interaction events
- Preserve: existing error strings


## Technical constraints
- Do not change validateWorld signature


## Definition of done
- Check implemented in validateWorld


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Check scene characters in validateWorld
nodes.body:
Add a loop over scene.characters ?? [] inside the per-scene loop of validateWorld that pushes a path-tagged error for ids absent from the characters Set.

## Acceptance criteria
- validateWorld returns the path-tagged error for an unknown scene character id
- Worlds with valid scene characters return no new errors


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/content/loader.ts
- Out of scope: tests
- Preserve: existing checks


## Technical constraints
- Code path: `game/src/content/loader.ts`


## Definition of done
- Loop added and the existing the-boys-room content still validates


## Clarifying questions
- None
